mapper.select: SELECT 'STORE' AS type, s.id AS id, s.name AS label, TRIM(COALESCE(a.road_address_text, a.jibun_address_text, '')) AS sublabel, CONCAT('/stores/', s.id) AS path FROM store s LEFT JOIN address a ON a.id = s.address_id WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store s WHERE (#{q} IS NULL OR #{q} = '' OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
